Probate

Q:  Does every estate have to go through probate?
A:  There are many situations where an estate does not require formal probate. Even when formal probate is not required, some form of legal process 
 is often necessary. This is especially true when an estate owns an interest in real property.

Q:  What is the filing fee for a Petition for Probate?
A:  The fee for filing a Petition for Probate is $435.00. The fee for filing an Objection or Response to a Petition for Probate is $435.00. 
 Certain subsequent petitions relating to probate are also $435.00. Please refer to the fee schedule for updated fee changes.

Q:  What are Probate notes?
A:  These are tentative rulings on the Probate cases that are set for hearing. Visit our Tentative Rulings page.
